Every NBCT has a story to tell…

What is National Board Certification?

  • A network of accomplished teachers who are taking leadership roles and affecting policy
  • A way to develop, recognize, and retain accomplished teaching
  • Rigorous, high standards, created by teachers, scored by teachers

The Five Core Propositions

National Board for Professional Teaching Standards
The Five Core Propositions set forth the profession’s vision for accomplished teaching.
1
Teachers Are Committed to Students and Their Learning
2
Teachers Know the Subjects They Teach and How to Teach Those Subjects to Students
3
Teachers Are Responsible for Managing and Monitoring Student Learning
4
Teachers Think Systematically About Their Practice and Learn from Experience
5
Teachers Are Members of Learning Communities

NBCT Eligibility

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Three years of teaching or counseling
  • Valid state or school counseling license

Questions about eligibility call (800) 22-TEACH

Component 1: Content Knowledge

National Board for Professional Teaching Standards | Computer-Based Assessment

Assessment Focus

Assessment Structure

Constructed Response Exercises

3 exercises (up to 30 minutes each to complete)

Selected Response Questions

Approximately 45 questions (up to 60 minutes total format)

Component 2: Differentiation in Instruction

National Board for Professional Teaching Standards | Portfolio Entry

Entry Requirements

Portfolio Format

Classroom-based portfolio entry

Core Focus

Demonstrate students’ growth over time and provide written commentary analyzing instructional choices.

Evidence Base

Primary samples of student work accompanied by detailed written commentary.

Evidence of Student Growth

Component 3: Teaching Practice and Learning Environment

National Board for Professional Teaching Standards | Portfolio Entry

Entry Requirements

Portfolio Format

Classroom-based portfolio and video entry

Core Focus

Demonstrate how candidates engage students and impact their learning

Evidence Base

Written commentary describing, analyzing and reflecting on teaching and interactions

Classroom Video & Practice

Component 4: Effective and Reflective Practitioner

National Board for Professional Teaching Standards | Portfolio Entry

Entry Requirements

Knowledge of Students

Group Info and Profile Form

Use of Assessment Data

Formative, Summative & Self-Assessments accompanied by Data/Results

Learning Communities

Professional Learning Need, Student Need, and Evidence

Getting Started: Registration Steps

National Board for Professional Teaching Standards | Roadmap
01
Register

Register at www.nbpts.org and confirm you meet eligibility prerequisites.

02
Fee Payment

Pay the $75 annual registration fee to proceed.

03
Components

Select desired components; fees can be paid now or later.

04
Standards

Review the specific standards for your certificate area.

05
Mentoring

Look for local area or online mentoring support groups.

More than a decade of research from across the country confirms:

  • Students taught by Board-certified teachers learn more than students taught by other teachers.
    • Estimates of the increase in learning are on the order of an additional one to two months of instruction.
    • The positive impact of having a Board-certified teacher (NBCT) is even greater for minority and low-income students.
  • This improvement in student outcomes is mirrored by NBCTs achieving stronger results on leading measures of teacher effectiveness, including robust classroom observations and value-added scores.

For more research: nbpts.org/wp-content/uploads/impact_brief_final.pdf

NBCTs are Improving Student Achievement

Research cited from a Mississippi study — included in the original deck as supporting evidence

Kindergarten Students taught by an NBCT are 31% more likely to achieve a proficient score on the Kindergarten Readiness Assessment than other students.

Without NBCTWith NBCT

Third Grade Students taught by an NBCT are 11% more likely to achieve a proficient score on the MAP Test in English Language Arts than other students.

Without NBCTWith NBCT

Source: The Impact of National Board Certified Teachers on the Literacy Outcomes of Mississippi Kindergarteners and Third-Graders, NSPARC Mississippi State University, 2017. Copied from nbpts.org/research/

NBCTs are 4 times more likely to remain in the classroom than the state average. This proven retention strategy is critical for addressing teacher shortages.

The estimated increase in the present value of a student’s lifetime earnings when taught by a National Board Certified Teacher (NBCT).

Economic Success

Having an NBCT can significantly boost a student’s long-term economic success. Highlighting the powerful, compounding value of investing in high-quality educator certification.

Two New Studies Add to the Evidence Base on Board-Certified Teachers’ Impact on Student Achievement

✅
Credential Association

Goldhaber & Cowan

“Board certification appears to be among the teacher credentials most consistently associated with student learning gains,” say researchers Goldhaber and Cowan (CEDR, CALDER, AIR).

➕
Learning Gains

Goldhaber & Cowan

Teachers achieving Board certification on their first attempt produce more than a month of additional learning gains. The assessment score itself is highly predictive of student achievement gains.

🎓
District Impact

Harvard Strategic Data Project

A 2012 analysis of LA Unified and Gwinnett County (GA) schools found NBCT students outperformed peers by two months in math and one month in English Language Arts.

Collaborative Professional Development

School leaders can provide…

  • Release Time
    Provide dedicated hours for portfolio preparation and planning.
  • Connections to Local Support
    Link candidates with cohorts, mentors, and regional networks.
  • Interest & Understanding
    Show genuine support by checking in and asking key questions: “How are things going?” · “How can I help?” · “What are you learning?”
  • Technical Support
    Assist with video recording equipment and classroom setup.
  • Recognition
    Acknowledge hard work and celebrate certification milestones.
